name: MCP client (connect to MCP servers)
description: Any AXF app as an MCP client: a server registry (records in the key-value store, tokens only in the platform secure store), Streamable HTTP sessions (JSON-RPC, SSE replies, session ids, version negotiation, pagination, cancellation, timeouts), browsing tools/resources/prompts and calling tools under the kernel interop exposure rules (mcp.call / mcp.call.write / mcp.call.destructive + confirmation). Pure-Kotlin engine in the kernel (ai.amberx.axf.kernel.mcp) mirrors framework/core/engines/mcp.ts and framework/python/axf_libs/mcp; all three replay spec/fixtures/mcp-client.json. Registers the kernel's axf.remote (RemoteServices) provider.

android.note: written without a compiler; CI compiles and runs :lib-mcp:testDebugUnitTest

placeholders.note: MCP server side (expose the app's surface@1 actions as tools) — not built; the client half is this library.
OAuth 2.1 authorization-code sign-in to MCP servers — not built; bearer tokens only.
Server→client requests (sampling, elicitation) are ignored, not answered.
